articles.summary: Herc Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HRI), one of North America’s leading equipment rental suppliers operating through Herc Rentals Inc. (“Herc Holdings,” “Herc Rentals” or the “Company”), today announced that Luis Machado has joined the company as senior vice president, chief legal officer and secretary. In this role, Machado will lead all aspects of Herc Holdings’ legal function, including contractual- and transaction-related legal activities and regulatory and litigation matters. In addition, he will oversee the company’s corporate governance and statutory reporting requirements. Machado has more than three decades of corporate legal experience at public companies across the construction, manufacturing, automotive, retail, food and beverage, and distribution industries. Most recently, Machado served as vice president, general counsel and secretary of TopBuild Corp., responsible for all board, governance, public reporting, MA, and litigation matters.
